name: CSG Difference
aliases: CSG Difference — SDF Difference, Subtraction of SDFs
definition: A CSG difference operation. Subtracts the first provided implicit function from the second, i.e., the result is solid where the second function is solid, except where the first is solid.
summary: CSG Difference subtracts one signed distance field from another to create a solid shape with holes, efficiently combining two fields into a single representation.
